title: Training #4 — Planet Observation Multi-Source Streaming + Agentic EO Lessons
purpose: Improve a public-good Earth-observation system by combining efficient large-stream self-supervised vision training with evidence-grounded agent evaluation. This is not a model-vs-model contest.

hardware_target.cpu_upgrade_rule: Do not add CPU blindly. Increase CPU only when decode/preprocess utilization is saturated while the GPU input queue is starved.

training_003_reference.diagnosis: Training and streaming were tightly coupled. 24 * 2.5345 ~= 60.8 samples/s, essentially matching the observed stream rate. Training #4 must decouple fetch/decode from GPU optimization and measure queue starvation explicitly.

sources: USGS/NASA Landsat official catalogue/assets where windowed access is available
Copernicus Sentinel-1/2/3 through official CDSE interfaces where legal/public and operational
rules: Do not download full satellite archives.
Prefer tile/chunk/COG/window reads and reuse one fetched source chunk for multiple local 512x512 patches.
Respect provider rate limits and backoff.
Cache only ephemeral research data outside Git.
Self-supervised training is allowed without pixel labels; supervised segmentation requires legitimate labels and separate geographic/time splits.

bottleneck_rules.data_or_network_bound: GPU utilization low + ready queue repeatedly empty + CPU not saturated
bottleneck_rules.cpu_decode_bound: GPU utilization low + ready queue empty + CPU/decode workers saturated
bottleneck_rules.gpu_bound: ready queue remains healthy + GPU utilization high
bottleneck_rules.remote_service_latency_bound: network bandwidth modest but fetch p95 high despite allowed concurrency and low local CPU pressure

systems: EVE-Instruct through official hosted API if available, otherwise official eve-esa checkpoint on ephemeral cloud L4
agentic_public_good_track.rule: EVE-Instruct is text-first in this experiment. Do not pretend it directly inspected raw pixels unless the tested endpoint/model demonstrably supports that modality. Give both systems the same structured evidence package for the reasoning track.

experimental_order: 500k-patch full Training #4 if smoke gates pass
generate shared lessons report from deterministic scores and observed failures

primary: preserve provenance and scientific claim boundaries
improve holdout behavior without tuning on B01-B10
identify shared architecture improvements for planetary observation
success_criteria.not_a_success_criterion: Declaring one organization/model globally better than another
